quarterly_data.signal: Intel's three largest customers (Dell Inc., HP Inc. and Lenovo Group Limited) accounted for 43% of net revenue in 2025 (45% in 2024, 40% in 2023); HP Inc. and Lenovo Group Limited each accounted for 12% for the period 2024-12-29 to 2025-12-27. In 2025 substantially all of the revenue from these three customers was generated from the sale of platforms and other components by the Intel Products operating segments.
